versions.changelog: Fix: hardcode API_BASE and APP_BASE to https://api.formora.dev and https://formora.dev to prevent security warnings from FORMORA_API_BASE/FORMORA_APP_BASE env var overrides
Add openclaw metadata block: declares required FORMORA_API_KEY and all optional env vars (Telegram/Email/X/Google Ads/Meta Ads) to resolve registry transparency warning.

Phase 3: Google Ads live paused campaign creation (campaign + budget + ad group + keywords + RSA). Meta Ads live paused creation. Shared daily/weekly budget caps across both platforms. ads-stop actively pauses live campaigns via API. Bilingual EN+ZH docs.
Initial release: create/edit/publish/distribute AI surveys; organic channels (Telegram/Email/QR/X); paid ads (Google Ads plan + Meta Ads live paused launch); shared budget caps; bilingual EN+ZH docs
